manifest.name: The Project view reference for the outpost's tabs and paste matching

context.rationale: The outpost view now opens a selected file in three tabs (Changes, Your copy, Code), matches pasted code that names no file to its file, and trusts a block the grammar cannot fully read only when a lexical scan confirms its edges. The code is committed on this branch. This is the one governing document that states the view, held by the consent gate until you decide: one paragraph naming the tabs and the matcher, one bullet for the edge rule, and two kits added to the code list. Approve, approve with edits, or return it.

items.title: docs/views/project.md

change.patch:
@@ -36,6 +36,17 @@ confirms the placement on the work computer. Comparing and copying never write
 a row. State icons come from `lib/kits/sync-status.js`,
 shared with the shortcut views.
 
+A selected file's working area is three tabs. **Changes** shows one card per
+changed block (`PowerShellUnits.compare`), stepped by swipe, arrow key or
+counter and opened full screen in the house deck; with a supplied work copy
+the cards become a selective update. **Your copy** reads a supplied copy block
+by block against GitHub and the version the work computer last held
+(`PowerShellUnits.versions`). **Code** is the file component, with its own Work
+copy line diff. Above the list, **Paste code to find its file** matches pasted
+PowerShell that names no file to the workspace's files
+([`powershell-match.js`](../../lib/kits/powershell-match.js)), and the app sends
+a page-wide paste there when no file is open.
+
 The rest of what the code keeps:
 
 - Source reads verify each file's Git blob bytes, and a draft keeps the file's
@@ -49,8 +60,13 @@ The rest of what the code keeps:
   rule; change both.
 - The Problems list is lexical heuristics; an empty one proves nothing about
   Windows PowerShell 5.1.
+- A block the grammar cannot fully read is choosable only when
+  `PowerShellUnits.edges` confirms both its edges sit at top level; the
+  grammar's own boundary is not trusted there.
 
 Code: `lib/alpineComponents/powershell-outpost-view.js` (the view),
+`lib/kits/powershell-units.js` (blocks, edges, versions),
+`lib/kits/powershell-match.js` (which file a paste belongs to),
 `lib/alpineComponents/powershell-file.js` (one file, in the view and its swipe
 deck), `lib/kits/powershell-outpost.js` (states, ledger),
 `lib/kits/powershell-workspace.js` (reads, drafts, publishing). `npm test`

items.commentary: The PowerShell outpost view section gains what a reader needs to find the new parts: the three tabs and which kit function each rests on, the paste matcher and the app's page-wide paste routing to it, and the rule that a block the grammar cannot read is choosable only when PowerShellUnits.edges confirms both edges. Nothing it said before is removed.
